_about: Nathanael Emmons (1745-1840), pastor at Franklin, Massachusetts, and the most rigorous of the New Divinity (Hopkinsian) theologians: Works, edited by Jacob Ide, with a memoir of his life (Boston, 1842, 6 vols, and a seventh volume, New York and Boston, 1850). Princeton copies. Volume numbers read off each title page. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
